audit_gate: If combined with H058 MathEffectGate later, its global hook otherwise rejects observer Popen. cadence.acceptance: Both queries and every original capacity predicate must finish: capture_start<=capture_end<=now<capture_start+2. Capture must finish before the current usable token expires; initial capture has its own finite2second budget.
cadence.age_origin: FIRST driver-query capture START, not completion
cadence.deadlines: Schedule from monotonic planned times, not finish+2. Cancel/reap each exact query against remaining capture/token time; the original15second per-query timeout cannot remain the effective work-authorization window.
cadence.first_check: A full completed PASS is mandatory before the first CUDA/scientific allocation. No sample or first failure means no science.
cadence.overdue: Missing/late/failed/foreign/out-of-order health or expired token latches failure. No late PASS may revive the attempt, no automatic retry and no per-block query fallback.
cadence.publication: Publish a bounded anonymous health-pipe frame successfully before making the token usable. Closed/backpressured/malformed/oversize publication is failure. No per-block/sample disk writes.

change: In new separately reviewed namespaces, remove only capacity_v1 delegation from per-call direct validate_lease wrappers. Do not alter admitted sources or science, and do not simplify other controller predicates in this first change.
cleanup: Invalidate further-work authority, cancel new captures, cancel only exact outstanding query identities and join observer within original single aggregate cleanup allowance.
Query timeout does not imply process absence. Keep actual query/direct/adopted waits, full live/unresolved identity treatment, pipe EOF and group absence.
An unjoined observer or unresolved helper means incomplete drain and cannot produce accepted success. Keep failure receipts behind original full guarded writer/caps.
Bounded-live/confirmed-absent retirement source remains separately necessary for periodic helper churn; increasing cumulative history bounds is not the efficiency solution.
external_arrival: Explicit timing change: an external arrival just after a sample may be detected by the next periodic observation rather than the next mathematical block.
At most2seconds of first-query age can authorize any continued boundary, regardless of block count. A FAILED new sample invalidates a still-young prior PASS immediately.
Preserve original UUID/title/PID-reuse classification, actual external/driver occupancy and full C3/H058/evaluator envelopes; peer disappearance releases no reserved bytes or storage credit.
OwnTorch cap stays percall. Own nonTorch and external occupancy remain in each full observation. Original two-driver-query non-atomic snapshot limitation remains.
full_uncached_boundaries: Admission, physical/logical attachment and before CUDA/ownership transitions retain full uncached capacity/controller checks.
Every actual scientific/operational write retains original accounting/source/name/planned-byte/write-body checks and their order.
A write/ownership barrier requests a NEW full capacity capture begun AFTER that barrier request; cached periodic PASS alone is insufficient.

After slow accounting returns, the actual pre-write point still requires a fresh full result plus exact current cheap checks. If not obtainable within original work/evidence limits, fail BEFORE writing. Detailed relative ordering must be reviewed in concrete integration; no original final source/name check is removed.
No science-clock reset, authority renewal, fallback or automatic retry is introduced.
limits: This is a fail-stop freshness contract, not a real-time scheduling or quota guarantee. OS starvation, a hung driver or an in-flight native/CUDA call may overrun. Next boundary rejects stale work and watchdog requests original owned stop; no guaranteed2second kernel preemption is claimed.
The two queries remain non-atomic and other users remain uncontrolled.
Observer thread shares existing admitted CPU/RSS/affinity limits; cadence/runtime fit is unmeasured. Driver inability to meet deadline fails rather than silently relaxing2seconds.
No model, math, corpus, support, update budget, checkpoint, precision or scientific-output change.

Keep bounded RAM ring/aggregates; persist only at existing authorized operational writer boundaries.

percall: Keep current ROOT authority/work/absolute expiry and GPU0-only policy.

Copy a stage/source/policy/worker-identity-bound immutable RAM capacity token and check age again after cheap checks. No subprocess or disk health read and no synchronous inventory fallback on this path.
This proposal changes no historical-accounting replay or charged-census behavior. Any separate lean-math change keeps its own review.
placement: One observer thread INSIDE the scientific worker, after actual parent gate and full source/lease/title setup. Its query children remain descendants of that existing worker session and owned tree.
Avoid a supervisor-thread query observer: its direct children would enter a tracker that assumes supervisor direct children are adopted scientific descendants, complicating group ownership.

Observer serializes the two fixed inventory queries, actual waits and unchanged full controller/own/external capacity arithmetic. No tensor/CUDA initialization, accounting mutation or disk write in observer.
Bind the actual absolute query executable/argv/PIPE behavior during later ROOT runtime qualification. Never resolve a new executable during math.
Do not share process-global accounting memo transactions across threads. Capacity/controller reads are uncached and independent of those transactions.

status_channel: Immutable RAM tuple and bounded anonymous frame include stage/worker/source/selected-policy identities, monotone sequence, capture-start/end/expiry, PASS/FAIL, original capacity totals and failure reason.

The only health writer is the actual owned worker. Supervisor validates exact stage/schema/identity, sequence and freshness. Full samples stay in a small bounded RAM ring for existing authorized receipts.

A supervisor watchdog independently observes health/expiry and must not wait behind main-loop accounting/census. It sets original cancellation and may signal ONLY the authenticated scientific leader through its held pidfd.
One original lifecycle owner still refreshes the owned tree and performs descendant/adopted waits/group cleanup. No concurrent ownership-table mutation or second cleanup allowance.
After independent health is wired, the old main-loop query becomes health/attachment verification rather than another redundant inventory source.

New post-request capture for each write/ownership barrier; publication failure and complete helper/observer cleanup.
